messages:
alex: opened PR for nova-3b onboarding + tokenizer tweak https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482 — can someone take a quick look at the tokenizer compatibility and quant profile? cc @jordan @priya :eyes:
jordan: on it. quick skim — vocab size bumped and there's a kv-cache key change. might break replay cache for older sessions. did you add a migration or compatibility shim?
alex: added a small shim in tokenizer/compat.py to accept old keys + a note in CHANGELOG. also pushed a fix for the lint failure that showed up in CI (flake8).
matt: I can review perf/quant profile this afternoon. do you have a preferred merge window? Dedicated validation wants a heads-up if we plan a canary.
priya: re: KV cache — can you add a unit test that replicates old key decoding? if not, we'll need a migration step in the runtime to avoid client 500s.
alex: yes, will add test now. added brief changelog entry too.
ci-bot: build failed — tokenizer_tests::test_kv_compat (1/23). logs: https://ci.internal/builds/482/logs
jordan: failing test looks like encoding edge-case — I'll take a quick look after lunch.
alex: pushed test + fixed the encode edge case. also tightened tokenizer docs. pinging again for reviews.
matt: will run the perf harness when I review. saw a ~4% throughput drop in a local quant run earlier, want to confirm on the cluster.
priya: small nit — please include the old proto version in the compat test so we don't regress later. otherwise seems fine.
alex: done, updated test with proto v1 vector.
ci-bot: all checks passed for commit sha abc123 — full test matrix green.
jordan: +1, left a tiny docstring comment but not blocking.
priya: approving once CI green — LGTM.
matt: perf run done: 5% throughput drop, tail latency unchanged. that's within acceptable range for Dedicated canary. I approve.
alex: awesome, thanks. planning to merge and schedule a canary deploy at 2024-11-07 18:30 UTC — will monitor errors and revert if >1% errors or latency regressions.
devops-bot: scheduled canary deploy for release/infra-models/nova-3b at 2024-11-07T18:30:00Z — monitor channel #incidents for alerts.
alex: merged and promoted to canary. will report back with metrics in ~30m. thanks everyone for quick reviews :tada:
jordan: thanks — noted the changelog and test. good to have the compat shim.
priya: closing loop: no errors in canary, merging to main in 1h. great work.
